The design demands combine the direct logic-tree evaluation at each condition with the ST20 transformation of the demand at the reference condition of 760 m/s, conditioned on the PGA of the same realization.

The AEP curves present the direct logic-tree calculation. The tabulated design values and UHS combine this evaluation with the ST20 transformation of the demand at the reference condition of 760 m/s, conditioned on the PGA of the same realization.
The ratios of the PSHA spectral ordinates to the NRC 2020 values range from 0.70 to 1.30 for the periods and site conditions compared.

The deaggregation plots show that the largest joint contributions to the seismic hazard for PGA occur at magnitude bin centers ranging between 4.875 and 5.125 and distance bin centers ranging between 18.75 and 31.25 km. The magnitudes at the peaks of the marginal distributions range from 5.125 to 6.875.
Structural periods: PGA and spectral periods of 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.50, 1.00, 2.00, 5.00, and 10.00 seconds.
